svg.aria-label: The Pet Physio Vet: a vet with a bird on her head, a dog and a cat
svg.title: The Pet Physio Vet
svg.desc: Hybrid of a vector trace and hand-drawn detail. Shapes are traced from the supplied bitmap (nine colour layers, cumulative masks, clipped to the disc). The face features are redrawn as clean geometry because the source resolves her face in only 45 pixels, too few to trace legibly.
